department: Department of Biological, Geological, and Environmental Sciences - BiGeA

deadline.value: The 42nd-cycle (2026/27) calls closed by 8 October 2026, which is for Fall 2026 entry; no Fall 2027 deadline is published yet.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme page or in its programme table.

supervisor.value: No supervisor agreement is needed to apply; the research project and supervisor are assigned after matriculation.
supervisor.quote: At the first Academic Board meeting, you will be assigned a research project and supervisor.

funding.value: Funded positions are awarded in ranking order, and some positions carry no scholarship.
funding.quote: Topic-specific positions are awarded following the ranking order of the applicants who are eligible for each position.

also.quote: Payment of fees is also mandatory for positions without a scholarship.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a second-cycle (Master's) degree or a recognised foreign equivalent; a bachelor's degree alone does not qualify under the call.
entry_route.quote: at least one of the following degrees: a) Laurea Magistrale, Magistrale a ciclo unico or Laurea Specialistica (Italian Second-Cycle Degree)

english_waiver.value: English is assessed at the oral exam. No exemption for an Indian degree is stated, so the department rule applies only to the exam.
english_waiver.quote: During the oral examination, the applicant’s English proficiency shall be assessed.

notes: Umbrella PhD: biology and environment are listed as also_fields; separate records exist for Molecular and Cell Biology and Future Earth. Agricultural, Environmental and Food Science and Technology is a separate PhD and is not saved.
name: Earth, Life and Environmental Sciences
